links.empty: No short links yet. Make one to see who clicks it.
links.name: Name
links.slugPlaceholder: Leave blank for a random one
links.confirmDelete: Delete {name}? Its clicks stay in your stats.
links.importHelp: Columns: name, url, slug (optional), domain (optional). Exports from the Umami fork work as they are.
links.domainsHelp: Use a domain or subdomain you own for short links, like t.example.com. Links on it live at its root: t.example.com/sale.
links.step1: At your DNS provider, add a CNAME record for the subdomain that points to {host}, where this dashboard runs. For a bare domain with no subdomain, use an A or ALIAS record to the same server instead.
links.step2: Make your host accept the domain and serve HTTPS for it: add it to your project's domains on Vercel or Netlify, or to your server's config and certificate. If Runlight runs inside your app, pass requests to rl.linkDomainResponse() in your middleware.
links.step3: Add the domain below. Runlight then checks that it reaches this dashboard.
links.removeNote: Removing a domain keeps its links, clicks, and stats: they move to {fallback} until you add the domain back, then return to it.
prompt.domainHint: Copy these steps with your addresses filled in, and paste them into it.
prompt.installHint: Copy the setup steps and paste them into it.
import.intro: Bring your short links over from another service, with their click history where the service shares it. Your key or password is used for this import only and never saved. Importing again skips links already here.
import.done: Finished: {links} links and {clicks} clicks imported, {skipped} already here.
import.stopped: Stopped after {done} of {total} links. Start again to carry on; links already imported are skipped.
import.history.full: Every click, with country, device, browser, and referrer.
import.history.daily: Clicks per day, without country or device.
import.history.none: Links only: the service does not share dated clicks.
import.umamiHelp: In Umami, create an API key under Settings, API keys. Stock self-hosted Umami has no API keys, so sign in with your username and password instead.
import.csvHelp: Columns: name, url, slug (optional), domain (optional). Exports from the Umami fork work as they are.
import.dubHelp: In Dub, create an API key under Settings, API Keys, with read access to links and analytics. Every click comes across on Business plans, daily counts on Pro, links only on Free.
import.bitlyHelp: In Bitly, go to Settings, API, enter your password, and generate a token. Bitly keeps daily counts only, as far back as your plan allows (none on Free).
import.shortioHelp: In Short.io, open Integrations and API and create a secret API key (a public key cannot read links). Short.io allows 60 statistics requests a minute, so this import paces itself.
import.rebrandlyHelp: In Rebrandly, create an API key under Settings, API keys. Rebrandly shares only total clicks, so links come across without history.
import.moveNote: Links on the service's own domain (bit.ly, dub.sh, rebrand.ly, short.gy) move to {fallback} with the same slug; branded domains are added under Custom domains.

share.intro: A share link shows this site's stats to anyone who has it, with no sign-in: the numbers, pages, sources, and locations. It never shows your short links, settings, or the site's address.
share.namePlaceholder: Who it is for, like a client or your team
share.revokeNote: Deleting a share link stops it working at once. Anyone who had it then sees a page saying so.
share.gone: This share link no longer works. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
live.title: Right now
live.nowHint: Anyone who viewed a page or did something in the last 5 minutes.
welcome.title: Add Runlight to {name}
welcome.lead: Waiting for the first visit. This page fills in by itself once it arrives.
goals.emptyHint: A goal counts what matters: a signup, a purchase, a thank-you page, a click on a button. Add one and it counts past visits too.
goals.overTimeValued: Conversions and revenue over time, each on its own scale
goals.name: Name
goals.hint.event: The name you send with runlight("Name") or a data-runlight attribute.
goals.hint.page: A path like /thanks. Use * for anything: /blog/* or /thanks*. A full URL works too.
goals.hint.link: Clicks on links whose address matches. Use * for anything, like https://buy.stripe.com/*, or start with / for your own pages.
goals.hint.selector: Any CSS selector. Or use Pick on my site: it opens your site, you click the element, then Use this.
goals.value.prop: An amount sent with the event
goals.intro: Goals turn visits into conversions. Each one counts an event, a page visit, or a click, and can carry a money value so you can see revenue by source and page.
goals.pastNote: Goals are counted from the data you already have, so a new goal shows past conversions too. Click goals start counting within about five minutes of being added.
